legacy_root.question: What breaks when activation is deferred? Enumerate the modes: a capability the router never selects is indistinguishable from one that does not exist; activation fails mid-task; a deactivated capability retains state; and per-session process multiplication (the measured stdio MCP duplication that drove commit exhaustion). Specify the OBSERVABLE signal that separates 'not selected' from 'not installed' at the moment of failure.

scenario.catching_architecture: [REDACTED] [REDACTED] with a three-bit availability signal (indexed, installed, selected) plus activation status, emitted at failure time; shared or lazy MCP spawn bounded by a recorded process-count curve that flags P1 only when superlinear.
scenario.on_this_estate: Both-states codes NOT_SELECTED vs INDEX_MISS_INSTALLED. Fixture stdio K=3. Eager curve [3, 6, 12, 24, 48] is linear (superlinear=False). Live process-table mcp-like count=0; live MCP-config stdio per session=0. Estate 23x65=2037 is named and not used as today.
procedure: Build an install tree with skill.alpha on disk and an index that lists it.
Ask the router for a task that does not select skill.alpha; record the three-bit signal (must be NOT_SELECTED).
Remove skill.alpha from the index only; leave the install file; record the signal (must be INDEX_MISS_INSTALLED).
Assert the two codes differ; reject a collapsed unavailable bit that is the same in both states.
Parse live MCP config for stdio server count; enumerate processes via PowerShell or /proc twin; simulate N sessions; flag P1 iff the curve is superlinear.
scenario.title: Index-miss vs not-installed vs not-selected

legacy_root.strongest_surviving_counterargument: A collapsed unavailable bit is what operators already see, and three bits on every miss looks like telemetry bloat. On this Linux worktree [REDACTED] DESIGN.json is absent and live MCP config files declare zero stdio servers, so the distinguishing signal and the process curve are proven on fixtures plus catalog-bound [REDACTED] activation hops, not on a shipped [REDACTED]. That limitation does not make not-selected identical to not-installed, and it does not license citing 23x65=2037 as today's measurement. Strongest surviving FOR: keep the three-bit signal even if spawn later becomes a shared pool; the signal is about discovery, the curve is about spawn policy.
